name: Aridai
overview: Aridai is a male biblical figure identified primarily as the son of Haman, as recorded in Esther 9:9. There is no additional information regarding his tribe or other personal details. His mention is brief and specific to his familial connection.
namesAndTitles: The name Aridai is a proper name possibly meaning 'delight of Hari.' This meaning, while not definitively established, suggests a personal name without a specific divine origin noted in Scripture.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Aridai as the son of Haman. No other family relationships or connections are provided beyond this direct paternal link.
scriptureSignificance: Aridai's significance in the biblical narrative is tied directly to his identity as Haman's son. His mention in Esther 9:9 serves to identify him among those related to Haman, who is a key antagonist in the story. Thus, Aridai's role is primarily genealogical, helping to provide context to the events surrounding Haman's family.
